notes: Area: Monmouth, Morris, Burlington and Camden counties NJ. Best data: Asbury Park Brewery (Squarespace JSON, full 2025-26), Bar Anticipation (iCal export, full 2025-26), The Homestead Morristown (Squarespace API, full 2025-26), Wonder Bar (Wayback copies of the apboardwalk.com JSON feed: Oct-Dec 2025, Apr-Oct 2026 + live), Stone Pony (Wayback homepage snapshots; national touring acts deliberately not recorded, only NJ/regional/tribute bands and Sunday Showcase bills), Tim McLoone's (Wayback), Red Bank / Asbury Park / Moorestown porchfests, Pier Village (Tribe Events API). Random Test's dates come from the band's own ReverbNation calendar (aggregator). Band filtering: solo artists, DJs, open mics, schools, choirs and community bands removed by hand plus a first-name heuristic; some single-word solo acts may remain and a few duos named after people may have been dropped. Gaps: The Saint (empty calendar), Wonder Bar/Pony Jan-Sep 2025, Jamian's past months, Morris County beyond Morristown/Morris Plains/Randolph (no Boonton/Dover/Rockaway venues found), Burlington County bars (Village Idiot, Robin's Nest, Gallagher's have no readable calendars), Camden County (Collingswood Porchfest/Second Saturday and Haddonfield series have no online lineups; Magnolia Porchfest lineup undated). asburyparkchamber.com and northtoshore.com calendars are Cloudflare-blocked to scripts; newjerseystage.com returned 403. Asbury Park Porchfest 2026 is scheduled Oct 31, 2026 (future-dated appearances); Red Bank Porchfest was Oct 3, 2026. Prodigal Sons (APB) and Prodigal Suns (Stone Pony) kept separate; Songbird at APB may be a duo/school act.
